verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Workflows as its automation engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review/approval, or rollback for workflows. Preview-before-save for AI SRE investigation rules and AI retrospective templates is a related feature, not automation versioning or rollback. The API changelog tracks Rootly's own API versions, not user automations, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
